tolerance.full: develops with prolonged and repeated use

addictionPotential: moderately addictive with a high potential for abuse
summary: Dichloropane is a phenyltropane stimulant that inhibits the reuptake of serotonin, norepinephrine and dopamine. Animal studies have reported a slower onset and longer duration than cocaine; it was identified as a designer drug in Sweden and Slovenia in 2016.
